description.en: Arenicolites interpretive section only: a real narrow U-shaped negative channel cuts the neutral host sediment, two vertical shafts connect in a simple basal bend without intervening spreiten. Top cap retains two openings; exposed gray front/clay sections reveal internal geometry. No suspended tube, identified maker, feeding assignment or copied excavated specimen. Teaching block width is nominal.
description.zh: Arenicolites潜穴示意剖面：真实窄U形负空间切入中性灰围岩，两竖井以简单底弯相连，中间无蹼状叠层；顶盖保留双开口，灰色前剖面/灰模可见内部结构。非悬空圆管，不指定制造者、取食方式或复制出土标本；教学块宽度属名义尺度。
